scope: cold archive page cache plus observed process storage reads; buffered write/flush/close regular-file extraction without fsync; not hardware-cache-cold, persistence or public CLI qualification
rss_scope: max_extraction_peak_rss is process-lifetime peak observed before verification, including startup; whole-process max additionally includes post-timing verification
postprocess_drain_scope: separate elapsed duration after process verification, before deleting owned outputs; excludes extraction/verification; not added to inner elapsed and does not imply persistence at command exit

statistics.pairing: same measured round; warmups excluded; ratios candidate/baseline
statistics.confidence_interval: 95% paired percentile bootstrap on six adjacent balanced two-round blocks; within-parity intervals resample six paired rounds; no multiplicity adjustment
statistics.median_definition: mean of central two order statistics for even sample counts

complete_record.reader_tid_parity_policy: round modulo 2; six measured and two preparatory samples per parity per variant
complete_record.device_counter_scope: global counters; corroboration only, parity does not imply identical physical mirror
complete_record.cold_gate: sync -d, fadvise DONTNEED, fincore RES == 0; sample must report process storage_io.read_bytes >= 50% of independent cold full-archive calibrated physical read bytes
